findings.title: Assert active selection and accessible action announcements
findings.why_it_matters: The keyboard acceptance test would still pass if every card permanently exposed aria-pressed=false and the matching live region never announced an action. A screen-reader user would then lose confirmation of which card is selected, whether Escape cancelled it, and whether a match or reorder succeeded. The plan explicitly requires selected/target states and focus/status verification; extend this existing interaction test so those regressions fail.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the existing keyboard counterpart test to assert aria-pressed=true immediately after selecting a source/output, false after matching and Escape, and the mapping live-region messages after selection, matching, cancellation and pair reorder. Add a select-again case proving same-card cancellation; verify opposite-kind cards expose the intended valid-target state.
evidence: src/ui/MappingRows.tsx:109 --           ? `${card.kind === "source" ? columnByKey.get(card.id)?.header : fields.find((f) => f.id === card.id)?.header} selected. Select its counterpart, or press Escape to cancel.`

docs/plans/2026-10-14-u2-paired-card-matching.md:19 -- Verification contract explicitly includes selected/target states and focus/status; inspected e2e specs contain no assertion against the mapping live-region messages or active aria-pressed=true.

residual_risks: Browser suites were not rerun by this read-only leaf because caller verification is active. context.json records pending Chromium rechecks, failing performance budgets, and unavailable Firefox/WebKit executables; initial results and screenshots do not establish acceptance.
testing_gaps: tests/e2e/row-mapping.spec.ts:79-102 exercises Alt+ArrowUp and upward grip drag, then restores the original order before downloading. Extend that owning test with Alt+ArrowDown/downward drag and a preview assertion while the reordered schema is still C,Gap,A; this verifies the newly added downward branch and that pair reordering preserves source associations in the actual output.
